confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on thin 2026 and crowd-sourced Beijing data, so they are medium-low quality. Wine is derived from the beer price, and the midrange meal is a judgement estimate. Hotel and hostel searches were rate-limited or returned only aggregator floor prices, so accommodation anchors are low confidence and rely mainly on general knowledge. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary of the RBA Exchange Rates page and was not verified by opening the page. CNY conversions assume about 6.8 CNY per USD, implied by the cited comparison-site conversions and not separately verified. July is peak season, which pushes accommodation prices up.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Beijing was priced directly from a 2026 Beijing nightlife guide (neighbourhood pint, mid-range cocktail ranges), a crowd-sourced Beijing comparison site (basic restaurant meal, beer, cappuccino), and budget hostel aggregator listings. Hotel anchors are general-knowledge estimates.
